summary: Extraction Vision Document for David Gelb (Jiro Dreams of Sushi, Chef's Table). Covers the uniqueness audit identifying Gelb's 'Cinematic Documentary Architecture' as a distinct capability no current expert provides. Maps business leverage across ghostwriting, content creation, LinkedIn authority posts, and brand storytelling. Details cross-expert stacking chains with Eric Roth (cinematic structure), Wright Thompson (character-driven narrative), Connelly (detail economy), Kallaway (hook engineering), Oren (taste development), and Pressfield (creative process). Identifies the gap Gelb fills: translating documentary filmmaking craft — character-first storytelling, emotion over information, false victory architecture, and the 'lean into the truth' editing philosophy — into deployable content and brand narrative workflows.
